And a very belated announcement on the most recent update released on the 19th Dec..... FESTIVE FLIGHTS!

Sorry High Flyers, we moved offices, then it was holiday time! Everything was a bit hectic in Mighty Land. 

So to Festive Flights! Zoom across the frosted skies with new Shooty friends: Citizen Cane, Mary Ecksmas, Menorobot and Kwanzaa Kat are ready to celebrate the holidays with you. Happy holidays from Mighty Games!

- 6 new pilots! 4 general, 2 secret

- Bug fixes and stability improvements - yes those pecky start-up and hyperspeed issues finally squashed!

Hope y'all took care of yourselves these holidays. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Economy Changes in Detail
notes.content:
So, what’s up with those tickets and coins? Things are looking a little different in the Shooty economy. I want to take you on a quick trip through the changes and let you know the score.
At a Glance Summary:
• Gold Tickets multiplied by 100
• Added new Prize Machine options
• Gun boosts can now be permanently unlocked
• New Duplicate pilot rewards
• Coin and Gold Ticket *bonus* rewards rebalanced to reflect the above


Gold Tickets x100
You get more. Things cost more. We did this to have more flexibility in the rewards we could give players.

New Prize Machine Options
We wanted to make the game more enjoyable and more accessible for players across the board. The *new Prize Machine options* give players the choice of paying more for a guarantee of not getting a duplicate pilot (which is new for the standard pilots) or they can pay less and risk getting a duplicate on the Gold pilots.
This means that newer players can collect Gold pilots more quickly and veteran pilots can save coins and time completing their collections.

Gun Boosts Unlocked Forever
You can now also spend Gold Tickets to permanently unlock your Weapon Boosts. We wanted to make unlocking your favourite weapon a but epic so we’ve gone for gold with it. Now you have more options of what to do with those Gold Tickets.


Duplicate Rewards
But, Tim, you say, I need more Gold Tickets now. Well, we have an answer. Duplicate pilots on the Coin Prize Machine offer tickets as a consolation prize and Gold Ticket pilots offer coins. You’ll also get Coins from Gold Ticket Prize Machine duplicates.


Coin and Gold Ticket Rebalancing
We made these changes to help balance the game. Here’s how we give late-game players more Coins and Tickets:
• Getting *Dupes on Coin Prize Machine* pilots gives you 25 Gold Tickets. It means late-game players can convert Coin to Gold Tickets and vice versa.
• The *“No Dupes” Prize Machine option for 5000 coins* is guaranteed to save players with 90% of the pilots coins and time. If you have all of the pilots except the latest pack you will save roughly 5000 coins per pilot
• *Unlocking weapons forever* means you aren’t spending coin as many coins on boosts 
• In-game Coin rewards are not changed
• Bonus from Gold pigs is unchanged
These changes help give new players a leg up, but we found they gave late-game players a massive boost. To partially offset this and make sure future players have a more balanced experience, we are giving out fewer coins from Daily Rewards past Day 12 (although there is a bug in the current patch 2.701 that makes it lower than it should be).

We have also reduced the Gold Ticket bonus from playing on higher Intensity from +100 Tickets on Shooty to +50, and from +200 to +100 on Screamy, which is closer to what the game balance needs (but we were unable to do when we couldn’t do half tickets).

TLDR;
We’re making changes with the long-term health of the game in mind. We’re giving you more ways to spend your Gold Tickets. We’re giving you ways to trade Coins for Tickets and back. We’re letting you unlock guns forever. We’re giving late-game player the option to complete their pilot sets with a lot less Coins and fuss. We’re giving new players a way to get Gold Pilots faster.

Give it a play and let us know how it feels.

Cheers,

Mighty Games Design Cat

notes.title: Mother's Day Update V2.7
notes.content:
Hey Mother Flyers!

Some famous mothers have stopped by to visit in this sentimental update! Pour out a cup of tea for Mother Goose, Mum-Ra the mummy, the very scary Queen Aliene, and Mothmom!

 7 new pilots! 4 general, 3 secret
 Quality of life tweaks
 Enemy rebalancing! See world-specific enemies more often!
 Bug fixes and stability improvements


Major fixes and tweaks

 Multiplying tickets! We’ve multiplied the Gold Ticket count by 100 everywhere to give us more options like...
 Weapon PERMANENT unlock. You heard right! With all your new tickets, you can choose to spend them on unlocking your weapon of choice forever. It goes shiny gold too!
 Added duplicate pilot rewards! Now when you get a duplicate pilot, you will receive coins or tickets as a consolation prize.
 New Prize Machine option: take your chance on a duplicate or use coins not to get one.
 More Pilot Pack deals! Fun collections of pilots will be offered more often.

notes.title: Easter Eggsellence Update V2.6
notes.content:
Spring is in the air, and it's time for the Easter Bunny to visit! 

Meet the grumpy Cross Buns, the disappointing Carob Bunny, and the goddess of dawn, Eostre! 

Update includes:

  6 new pilots! 4 general, 2 secret
  Quality of life tweaks; and

User interface polish and improvements, including fixes for:

       issue with fitout not loading properly after going to intensity screen from game over banner
       ufo laser behaviour to maintain aim
       hide purple backdrop when continuing daily mission
       carousel resetting to home position when removing head pack after buying all items in pack
       daily mission coin collection going into negative
       fly through rings out of order false success
       added ‘resume’ and ‘end game’ buttons to pause menu on desktop
       leaderboards being broken in some circumstances.

Hop to it!

notes.title: Bugs and Reporting
notes.content:
Hey Shooty Shooters,

Thank you for making this launch awesome! 

If you are experiencing any bugs, we'd love to know about it. In order to fix them ASAP, can you please provide the following when posting about it:

- OS
- Memory
- Graphics Card (incl VRAM)
- Free HD space

If you can provide a screenshot/video and a brief description of what you were doing just prior to the bug appearing, that would be super helpful too.

Stay Shooty!

- Mighty Team
